findings.title: Stop on provider errors and keep them out of refusal counts
findings.disposition: Declined for sample.mts: it is the one-shot script that ran, committed and hash-pinned before any paid call, so changing it would misdescribe the run. The retained run has no such rows: all 98 outcomes are stored or refused, and run-finished.json records no ledger block and no unexpected request. The refusal-count half is covered by the tally guard below.

findings.title: Keep operational outcomes out of plan-refusal metrics
findings.disposition: Accepted as a guard: tally.mts now fails on any outcome other than stored or refused instead of counting it as a refusal. Regenerating the tally with the guard reproduced tally.json exactly apart from its timestamp; the retained tally.json is unchanged and the manifest hash for tally.mts was refreshed.
